CustomField.label: Payer Override
CustomField.description: CR-17: bill this quote to a different self-pay account than the one the account's Payer Type resolves to. Needs a reason; approval is added with the approval matrix (phase 5b).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank to bill the payer from the account's Payer Type. Set only to bill this quote to another self-pay account; a reason is required.

lookupFilter.errorMessage: The payer override must be a Self-Pay account.
